Stance. You adopt a taunting defensive posture. While in Royal Guard you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, and an enemy that begins its turn adjacent to you and then targets an ally is flat-footed against your next attack this round (representing enmity). Your combo bonus damage is halved while this stance is active. Entering or leaving the stance is a single action (@UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.ca203eb3b1f22fda]{Release Royal Guard}).

Apply: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.a74a5130c0f43674]{Enter Royal Guard}
